title: Fortified Netherite Set
description: Mod that adds Fortified Netherite along with other cool stuff!
body:
# **About the mod**

Fortified Netherite is a Minecraft mod that adds a new Fortified Ancient Debris, which you can use to make Fortified Netherite Ingots which allow for powerful weapons!

# **What the mod adds**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- **Fortified Ancient Debris**
  
- **Fortified Netherite Scrap**
  
- **Fortified Netherite Ingot**
  
- **Fortified Netherite Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe**
  
- **Fortified Netherite Apple (this is stupid)**
  
- **Enchanted Fortified Netherite Apple**

- **Fortified Netherite Armor**

- **New potion effect that adds more Armor Protection** **(note: to get this, brew a fortified ingot with a tulip in the middle)**
  
- **New Fortitude Enchantment that is twice as strong as protection and can be applied to Netherite and Fortified Netherite Armor**


</details>



Note: All of these are craftable, which means you can obtain them in Survival!
